label: FACIS Simulation — OPC UA Adapter
info:
FACIS Simulation — OPC UA Demo Server Adapter

Demo fixture, not a production OPC UA server. Exposes the latest
energy-meter snapshot as 13 Double variables so the industrial
ingestion reference flows have a live OPC UA source to read from
(services/industrial-ingestion-service/orce/).

Endpoint: opc.tcp://<pod>:4840, SecurityPolicy None, anonymous,
read-only. NodeIds: ns=1;s=FACIS.EnergyMeter.<metric> with the same
metric names as the Modbus register map (docs/api/modbus-reference.md).

Registration is self-sustaining and confirmation-gated:
  - a start-time reset clears stale registration state on every deploy;
  - a periodic heartbeat re-registers any missing variables (idempotent),
    so registration survives partial deploys and server restarts;
  - the server emits one confirmation per successful addVariable, tracked
    into the `opcua_registered` global;
  - the writer only publishes once all 13 variables are confirmed present;
  - a catch-driven reconcile drops the cached set when the address space
    is lost ('Variable not found' / 'Server is not running') and triggers
    a re-register.
Each function node reports node.status() so registration progress is
visible in the editor without extra debug nodes. Values refresh every
second from the `latest_meters` global written by the Feeds tab.
